identity.vibe: Sporty, Premium, Automotive, Edgy yet Professional, Trustworthy

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

layout_and_spacing.marketing_pages: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). Asymmetrical, generous negative space. Use p-12, py-24, py-32 for sections. Full-bleed images. High-contrast typography-led discovery.
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid Mode B. Dense, 1px solid borders, Shadcn UI components. Functional, compact, strictly utilitarian.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-aligned typography for modern, cinematic feel. Center alignment only for specific call-outs or marquee.

component_strategy.marketing_ui: Raw HTML/Tailwind for creative layouts. No generic Shadcn cards for marketing. Use react-fast-marquee for kinetic 'ANDERS - BESSER - MUTIGER' ticker.
component_strategy.admin_ui: Heavily use Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialogs, Forms, Inputs, Tabs). Override default radii to rounded-sm for a sharper, sporty look.
component_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary: Solid Adrenaline Red with white text. Secondary: Transparent with 1px border. Hover states must increase brightness/shift to red.
component_strategy.navigation: Crystal Glass header over hero section. Must include Logo, Links, DE/EN toggle, and CTA. Sticky on scroll with z-50.
component_strategy.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="hero-cta-button"').

page_sections.name: Hero Section
page_sections.style: Full viewport height. Background image of black sports car driving. Gradient overlay (bg-black/60 to transparent) to ensure text contrast. Massive left-aligned typography.

page_sections.name: Kinetic Marquee
page_sections.style: react-fast-marquee spanning full width. Text outline style: text-transparent, text-stroke-white (using custom CSS or webkit-text-stroke), text-6xl, uppercase.

page_sections.name: About Instructor (Nadine Stäubli)
page_sections.style: Split layout. Right: Confident woman driving image. Left: Text focusing on modern, professional lessons with heart.

page_sections.name: Vehicle Fleet & Services
page_sections.style: Asymmetric Bento Grid highlighting Audi S3, Opel OPC, Range Rover Sport. Dark surfaces with 1px border. Hover effects: image slight zoom, border turns red.

page_sections.name: Pricing & Reviews
page_sections.style: Brutalist pricing tables. Google-style testimonials in a sleek horizontal scroll or grid. High contrast text.

page_sections.name: Contact & Footer
page_sections.style: Darkest background (#050505). Shadcn form inputs modified to dark theme (bg-transparent, border-white/20, focus:border-red-500).

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Cinematic and deliberate. No bounce. Speed and precision.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Fade in and slight upward translation (y: 20px) on scroll using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons and cards should use slight brightness increase or border color shift (e.g., border-transparent to border-[#FF2E00]).

hero.description: Black sports car driving fast on suburban road
hero.usage: Main hero background image (requires black/60 overlay for text legibility)

fleet.usage: Representing the premium fleet (Audi S3 / Range Rover vibe)

atmosphere.usage: Background for Testimonials or Pricing to establish Swiss location

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the JSON guidelines strictly to implement the UI.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout. Do not over-rely on Shadcn Card for landing page aesthetics.
Build a dedicated Admin CMS at '/admin' route (use Shadcn extensively here for tables/forms/dashboard).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' matching their function (e.g., data-testid='submit-contact-form').
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Implement language toggling (DE/EN) structure via context or simple state, defaulting to DE.
